entities.summary: Amorite, a notable figure in the history of Iraq, associated with Babylonian and Assyrian Empires (1894 BCE–1595 BCE). Preceded by Old Babylonian Kingdom and Hammurabi. Their legacy influenced Neo-Assyrian Empire and Persian.
